grammarAlternative.limitation: POS membership alone does not establish grammatical Vietnamese. No agreement filter or human memory result is assumed.

limitations: Two Wiktionary editions are overlapping editorial sources.
Tatoeba is a small translated-sentence corpus.
Exact n-gram presence is not tokenized word frequency.
No human memorability study was performed.

sentenceHoldout.limitation: This separates sentence IDs, not authors, templates, or domains. It is not an external corpus or a memorability test.
sentenceHoldout.split: SHA-256 of decimal sentence ID, first 4 bytes as big-endian integer modulo 5. Bucket 0 is held out.
